newsitem.title: USA: MCI, Rostelecom in Internet supply pact.
newsitem.headline: MCI, Rostelecom in Internet supply pact.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp said Wednesday it had been chosen by AO Rostelecom, the primary Russian international telecoms operator, to provide the largest Internet access connection ever installed to Russia.

The purpose of the project is to provide Internet services to Internet Service Providers (ISPs) and individual users in Russia and effectively marks Rostelecom's entry into the full-scale Internet access business, an MCI spokesman said.
Rostelecom will provide access for the first stage of its Internet Project through MCI, the spokesman said. MCI would also be considered if Rostelecom opts to add further capacity.
Initially, Rostelecom and MCI plan to install this year six E-1 circuits to transmit data at a rate up to two megabits a second and tied to MCI's 622 megabit Internet backbone.
The connection allows the equivalent of about 643 pages of text to be transferred every second, MCI said.
Then in 1998, Rostelecom and MCI will install two additional E-1 circuits via a Pacific Ocean cable to Khabarovsk in the Eastern part of Russia.
The companies said Russia has an estimated 21,940 Internet web sites and 220,000 connections to the Internet citing a recent report by the International Telecommunication Union.
